# cdc-debezium-mariadb-nats

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> Debezium Server — MariaDB Binlog → NATS JetStream CDC
>
> Captures all writes to MariaDB tables and publishes them as
> messages to NATS JetStream. No application code changes required.
>
> Event subject: {topic.prefix}.{database}.{table}
> e.g.: cdc.mydb.orders, cdc.mydb.users
>
> Dependencies (must be included in the tenant overlay):
> - k8s/components/apps/brokers/nats  (or external NATS)
>
> Requirement: MariaDB must have binlog enabled with ROW format.
> binlog_format=ROW
> binlog_row_image=FULL
> The connecting user needs REPLICATION SLAVE and REPLICATION CLIENT privileges.
>
> The tenant overlay must provide:
> 1. Secret (debezium-mariadb-nats-secret) with:
> MARIADB_HOST=mariadb-host
> MARIADB_PORT=3306
> MARIADB_USER=<user>
> MARIADB_PASSWORD=<password>
> NATS_USER=<user>
> NATS_PASS=<password>
> 2. Patch on ConfigMap for debezium.source.table.include.list
> (e.g.: mydb.orders,mydb.users)
> 3. Patch on ConfigMap for debezium.source.database.include.list
> (e.g.: mydb)
> 4. Patch on ConfigMap if NATS is in a different namespace:
> debezium.sink.nats-jetstream.url
>
> Note: the nats-stream-init Job auto-resolves the NATS namespace
> via the Kubernetes downward API — no patch needed for it.
>
> Offsets: persisted on PVC (debezium-mariadb-nats-data).
> If the PVC is deleted, Debezium re-snapshots from the beginning.
>
> Replicas: always 1. Multiple instances would produce duplicate events.
